name: Dangerous Game
text:
The stones and trees whisper in your ears, warning you of those who would dare to turn the hunt on you. Even if you're not Searching, you always get a secret Perception check to find signs and evidence of creatures who are Tracking you, Investigating you, using Hunt Prey on you, or otherwise hunting you.

In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth and Survival checks against such creatures as well as checks to Recall Knowledge about them.
